siteEventsNone: Nothing is planned just now. Check back soon.
siteEventsFromCalendar: The calendar's public events appear here. Mark an event to show on the website when you edit it in the calendar.

calSubscribeHint: A private link shows the events meant for you, and the days the school is closed, in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook.
calSubscribeApple: Add to Apple Calendar or Outlook
calSubscribeOnce: Keep this link to yourself: anyone who has it can read your calendar. It is shown only now.
calSubscribeExisting: You made a calendar link on {date}. It was last read {read}.
calSubscribeResetHint: The old link stops working at once, on every device that used it.
calSubscribeDelay: Calendar apps check the link on their own schedule, so a change can take up to a day to appear. Changes and cancellations also reach you as notices.
calUpdateBody: The change shows on the calendars of the people it is for straight away.
settingsSecondaryCalendarHint: Shown beside Gregorian dates on the calendar. Holidays set by the moon still need marking as expected.

lrnGateLocked: Answer the questions above to go on.
lrnNewAttempt: Fresh start. Your best score stays.
lrnResumeHint: You were part way through this lesson.
lrnResume: Pick up where you left off
lrnBelowPass: You need {score}% to finish. Start again to try for it.
lrnRetryHint: Answer every question again. Your best score stays.
lrnPreviewHint: Answers you give in the preview are marked here and not saved.
lrnLessonShown: Lesson saved and shown to students
lrnLessonSavedHidden: Lesson saved. Students still see the version shown before.
lrnChangesWaiting: Students see the version you last showed them. Saved changes wait until you show them.
lrnBlocksSummary: Parts: {parts} · Questions: {questions}. Students meet them in order.
lrnAnswersNeeded: Give at least one accepted answer.
lrnGapsNeeded: Put at least one blank in square brackets.
lrnGapEmpty: Every blank needs an answer inside its brackets.
lrnGapChoices: A blank to choose from needs at least two choices.
lrnRangeOrder: The lowest value must not be above the highest.
lrnTranscriptNeeded: Audio needs a transcript or captions.
lrnNoWrittenBody: Written answers students send in this module's lessons show here for you to read and mark.
lrnErrSettled: This question is already answered. Reload the lesson to see where you are.
lrnErrWordLimit: The answer is longer than its word limit.
lrnErrPointsOver: Give no more points than the question is worth.
lrnErrResponse: That answer does not fit this question. Reload the lesson.
lrnErrNothingToRetry: This lesson has no questions to answer again.
lrnErrModuleDraft: Open the module to students first; its lessons are shown with it.
lrnErrDuplicateIds: Two parts of the lesson share an id. Remove one and add it again.
lrnPairIncomplete: Every pair needs a prompt and an answer.
lrnErrSortGroup: Every item needs one of the groups.
lrnOrderHint: Use the arrows to put them in order.
lrnLockedTitle: This lesson is not open yet
quizAnswerKept: Answer kept. It is marked when you hand the quiz in.
quizPointsFromQuestions: Worth {points} points, the total of the quiz's questions.
quizStartedHint: Students have started this quiz, so its questions can no longer change. The settings still can.
quizRevealHint: They always see their score unless you keep results until you return them.
quizShuffleHint: Each student meets them in their own order. Text between questions stays in place.
quizPendingMarks: Your teacher still has written answers to mark, so this score may rise.
quizResultsLater: Your teacher will return the results.
quizAttemptsHintUnlimited: Answer the questions, then hand the quiz in. You can take it again after.

quizHandInBody: Every question is answered. Handing in marks them all.
errQuizGate: A quiz has no continue gates; students see every question at once.
errQuizRubric: A quiz is marked by its questions, so it takes no rubric.
errFormatFixed: Work already assigned cannot become a quiz, and a quiz cannot become other work.
errNotQuiz: This work is not a quiz.
editorAddRowAtEnd: Add a row at the end
editorAddColumnAtEnd: Add a column at the end
annArchiveBody: It leaves every feed. Its record and who read it are kept.
annSendAtHint: Leave empty to send when you choose Send.
annUpdateBody: People already have it. Tell them it changed, or save the change quietly?

filesEmptyModule: Files you put in this module's lessons appear here. You can also upload files to use later.
filesDeleteUsed: {list} will show it as removed until you restore it. It stays in the trash for 30 days.
filesDeleteUnused: It stays in the trash for 30 days, where you can restore it.
filesTrashHint: Deleted files stay here for 30 days, then go for good.
fileRemoved: This file was removed or can't be opened.
filesVersionsHint: Files replaced here stay for 30 days. Restoring one makes it current again, and the current file becomes a previous version.
fileReplaceKind: Replace a file with the same kind of file: a picture with a picture, a PDF with a PDF.
fileNearlyFullSchool: Your school's storage is {percent} full: {used} of {limit}.
fileNearlyFullClass: This class's files are {percent} full: {used} of {limit}.
fileNearlyFullModule: This module's files are {percent} full: {used} of {limit}.
fileNearlyFullPerson: Your own files are {percent} full: {used} of {limit}.

fileQuotaModule: This module's files are full. Delete files it no longer needs in its Files tab.
fileQuotaPerson: Your own files are full. Delete work you no longer need, or ask your school for more room.
filesUsageNearlyFull: Nearly full. Delete files that are no longer needed, or ask a school administrator for more room.
settingsStorageHint: Everything uploaded in this school counts here once, however many documents show it.
earlyYearsFeatureToggleHint: Lessons for young children, one screen at a time and read aloud, with tap and drag activities, a home of big cards, and sign-in badges.
featureNotInPlan: Not in your school's plan. Ask Farida to include it.
featureNotInPlanError: That module is not in your school's plan.
lrnPictureUnnamed: Describe each picture that has no words, so everyone can tell what it shows.
capExamsManage: Manage exams, coursework rules and grade scales
capBadgesIssue: Print sign-in badges for young children
examSubtitle: Exam sessions and the coursework set for them, and the grade scales and programmes your classes grade on.
examRuleDeclarationHint: Students confirm the work is their own before handing it in.
examRuleAiEvidenceHint: Students who used AI name the tool and date, say how they used it and attach what it produced.
examSessionsEmptyHint: Add the sessions your students sit, from the boards' official list or your own exams, so teachers can set coursework for them.
examRetireHint: Teachers can no longer choose it for new coursework. Work already set for it stays, and is kept until its date.
examBoardHint: A board of your own, for exams Farida does not keep sessions for: your mocks, a national exam or another board.
examTitleNeeded: Enter a name in English or Arabic.
examNoOwnBoards: Add a board of your own on the Boards tab to enter sessions for it.
examOfficialHint: Its keep-until date follows the board, and you can change it after adding it.
examNoOfficialLeft: Every official session is already added.
examKeepUntilHint: Work is listed for review on this date. Nothing is deleted without someone deciding to.
examBelowBoardWarning: The board asks for work to be kept until {date}, for results enquiries and appeals. Work deleted before then cannot be sent if the board asks for it.
examBelowBoardConfirm: Keep it for less time anyway
examReasonHint: Kept in the history, so the next person knows why it changed.
examHistoryHint: Every change to your sessions and boards, who made it and why.
examErrSeriesUnknown: That session is no longer offered. Reload to see the current list.
examErrBoardUnknown: Choose one of your school's boards.
examErrKeepUntilEarly: The keep-until date must come after the session.
examErrBelowBoard: That date is earlier than the board's. Confirm you want to keep the work for less time.
examBelowBoardNeeded: Confirm it, or choose the board's date or a later one.
editorAiUseHint: Say which AI tool you used and how, and keep what you asked and what it gave you as evidence.
editorAiUseHowPlaceholder: For example: an outline I then rewrote in my own words
authenticationAfterDeclaration: You can confirm the work once the student's declaration is in.
authenticationCannotHint: Say why you cannot confirm this is the student's own work. The grade will not go back, and your school's exams officer will see it to follow up.
authenticationConditions: It was done under the conditions the board sets, and any help given is recorded below.
authenticationConfirm: Confirm it is their own work
authenticationFinal: Confirmed work is final: it cannot be sent back for revision.
authenticationFinalNoRevision: This work is confirmed and final, so it cannot be sent back for revision.
authenticationHelpHint: Anything beyond general guidance, so the board can take it into account.
authenticationMarked: I marked it against the board's criteria myself.
authenticationNeededToReturn: Confirm this is the student's own work before returning the grade.
authenticationOwnWork: To the best of my knowledge, this work is the student's own.
authenticationReasonNeeded: Say why, for the exams officer.
courseworkAssessedAfterSave: Once the assignment is saved, you can set it as coursework for an exam session.
courseworkAssessedAuthenticates: You confirm each student's work before returning the grade.
courseworkAssessedDeclares: Students sign a declaration when they hand in.
courseworkAssessedHint: For work an exam board moderates, such as coursework, internal assessments or projects.
courseworkComponentHint: The board's name for it, such as Component 2: Investigation.
declarationAgreeNeeded: Agree to the declaration to hand in.
declarationAi: Where I used an AI tool, I have said so in the work, with the tool, the date and how I used it.
declarationAiBlock: Add an AI use block to your work where you used it, saying which tool, when and how.
declarationAiBlockEvidence: Add an AI use block to your work where you used it, saying which tool, when and how, with screenshots of what you asked and what it gave you.
declarationAiNeeded: Say whether you used an AI tool.
declarationAiNo: No, I did not use any AI tool
declarationAiQuestion: Did you use an AI tool for this work?
declarationAiYes: Yes, and I acknowledged it in the work
declarationConsequence: I understand that work found not to be my own may not be accepted, and the exam board may be told.
declarationHelp: I had no help beyond what my teacher allowed, and I have not shared this work with other students.
declarationLaterHint: Your teacher handed this work in for you. Sign the declaration so they can confirm it.
declarationOutstanding: This work counts for an exam. Sign your declaration that it is your own work.
declarationPaperHint: Record that the student signed the declaration on paper. Keep the paper, or add a scan here.
declarationSources: Where I used anyone else's words, ideas, pictures or data, I have said where they came from.
examCourseworkEmptyHint: Teachers set an assignment as coursework for one of your sessions in its details.
courseworkErrDeclarationNeeded: Sign the declaration to hand this work in.
courseworkErrAiMissing: You said you used AI. Add an AI use block to your work saying which tool, when and how.
courseworkErrAiIncomplete: Finish each AI use block: the tool, the date, how you used it and, where asked, the evidence.
courseworkErrAiInWork: Your work acknowledges using AI. Answer yes to the AI question.
courseworkErrDeclarationOutstanding: The student's declaration is still to come.
courseworkErrFinal: This work is confirmed and final.
courseworkErrNotForQuiz: A quiz cannot be assessed coursework.
gradingBandIncomplete: Give every grade a name and the lowest percentage that earns it.
gradingBandsHint: Each grade starts at its percentage and runs up to the next. One starts at 0, so every score has a grade.
gradingBandsKeepHint: Grades already given keep the grades they were given. Work graded from the date below uses these.
gradingBoundRepeated: Two grades start at the same percentage.
gradingByGradeLevelOption: The programme for its grade level
gradingClassProgrammeHint: Choose one when two programmes share this class's grade level.
gradingClassScaleHint: A scale for this class alone, in place of its programme's.
gradingDisplayGradeLong: The grade only, such as A
gradingDisplayGradeScoreLong: The grade with the score, such as A · 18 / 20
gradingGradeLevelsHint: Classes in these grades follow the programme unless another programme shares the grade.
gradingLabelRepeated: Two grades have the same name.
gradingNoFloor: One grade must start at 0, so every score has a grade.
gradingProgrammeBoardHint: Coursework set in its classes usually counts for this board's sessions.
gradingProgrammeScaleHint: The scale its classes grade on, unless a class has its own.
gradingProgrammesEmptyHint: Add the programmes your school runs, such as IGCSE or the IB Diploma, to set each class's scale by its grade level.
gradingProgrammeTitleHint: For example: IB Diploma, IGCSE, American High School
gradingRegraded: Graded again: {terms} term grades and {work} pieces of work.
gradingRegradeHint: Grades already given keep their grades when a scale changes. This gives a term's grades again on the grades in force today.
gradingRetireHint: No class or programme may still use it. Grades given on it keep their grades.
gradingRetireProgrammeBody: Classes that follow it by grade level follow no programme after this. Classes chosen for it must be moved first.
gradingScalesEmptyHint: Add the scales your school grades on, starting from IGCSE, IB, US or Egyptian grades, so scores show as grades.
gradingStartFromHint: Boards set real boundaries for each paper and session; adjust these to your school's.
courseworkErrScaleInUse: Classes or programmes still grade on this scale.
courseworkErrProgrammeInUse: Some classes are set to this programme. Move them first.
gradingCategoriesHint: Weigh each kind of work in the term grade, adding up to 100. With none, every piece of work counts by its points.
gradingWeightsTotal: The weights add up to {total}%; they need to make 100%.
gradingCategoryIncomplete: Give each category a name and a weight.
courseworkCategoryHint: Where this work weighs in the term grade, as the class's programme sets.
courseworkErrCategoryUnknown: Choose one of this class's categories.
capPrivacyManage: Keep the data protection register: retention rules and legal holds
privacySubtitle: How long the school keeps the records of people who have left, who is due for review, and what must be kept.
privacyReviewCaption: People who have left the school
privacyNoLeaversHint: Students and staff appear here once they belong to none of your schools.
privacyNoRulesYet: The school has not set how long it keeps the records of people who have left, so nothing comes up for review.
privacyExamHint: These sessions' keep-until dates have passed. Check that no appeal or enquiry about results is still open before the work is destroyed.
privacyNoHoldsHint: A hold keeps everything about a person while a claim, an investigation or a records request is open.
privacyRulesHint: Records of people who have left come up for review once their time is over. Nothing is destroyed without someone approving it.
privacyStudentsHint: England's guidance keeps a secondary pupil's record until their 25th birthday. Where the law leaves it to the school, choose a number of years.
privacyStaffHint: England's guidance keeps a personnel file for six years after someone leaves. Leave it empty to keep staff records.
privacyRuleYearsOption: A number of years after leaving
privacyYearsInvalid: Enter a whole number of years from 1 to 100.
privacyHoldHint: While the hold is on, nothing about this person can be erased, whatever the retention rules say.
privacyHoldReasonHint: The claim, investigation or request it is for, so whoever releases it knows why it was placed.
privacyHoldReasonNeeded: Say why the hold is needed.
privacyReleaseHint: Once released, this person's records follow the school's retention rules again.
privacyErrPersonUnknown: This person has never been a student or staff member of the school.
privacyErrHoldUnknown: This hold has already been released.
privacyClockBeforeReceipt: The clock cannot start before the request was received.
privacyClockUk: UK GDPR: one calendar month from when the clock starts, moved to the next working day if it ends on a weekend or holiday. Complex requests can be extended by two months.
privacyClockEnglandRecord: England: a parent's request to see the educational record is answered within 15 school days.
privacyClockFerpa: FERPA: records are made available for inspection within 45 days.
privacyClockEgypt: Egypt: requests are answered within 6 working days.
privacyClockOther: No clock is set by law for this request. Enter the date the school commits to.
privacyClockFromHint: The day you confirmed who is asking, or received any fee. The same as the day received when neither was needed.
privacyDueNeeded: Enter the date it will be answered by, on or after the day the clock starts.
privacyExtendHint: A complex request may take two further months beyond {date}. Tell the person within the first month, with the reason.
privacyExtendReasonNeeded: Say why the request needs longer.
privacyLawEnglandRecord: England, a parent and the educational record
privacyNoRequestsHint: Log each request to see, correct or erase records as it arrives, so its deadline is tracked.
privacyOutcomeNoteHint: What was sent or changed, or why the request was refused.
privacyPersonHint: The person the records are about.
privacyErrNoExtension: Only a UK GDPR request can be extended, and only once.
privacyBreachActionsHint: How the breach was contained and what now stops it happening again.
privacyBreachActionsNeeded: Say what was done about the breach.
privacyBreachLawOther: No law sets who must be told. Record what the school decided and why.
privacyBreachTitleNeeded: Give the breach a short title.
privacyBreachWhatHint: What data, whose, how it got out, and what could follow for the people affected.
privacyDiscoveredHint: When the school learned of the breach. The regulator's 72 hours start here.
privacyDiscoveredNeeded: Enter when the school became aware of the breach.
privacyErrBreachNoticesOpen: Record whether the regulator and the people affected were told before closing the breach.
privacyNoBreachesHint: Log every breach the school learns of, reported or not, so the regulator's deadline is tracked and the register is complete.
privacyPeopleDue: The people affected must be told by {date}.
privacyPeopleInvalid: Enter a whole number of people.
privacyPeopleNoDelay: The people affected must be told without undue delay.
privacyPeopleOptional: The law does not require telling the people affected.
privacyRegulatorDue: The regulator must be told by {date}.
privacyRegulatorOptional: The law does not require telling the regulator.
privacyRiskHint: UK GDPR: tell the regulator unless harm is unlikely, and the people too when the risk is high. Egypt: tell both whatever the risk.
privacyWhyNotToldHint: Leave empty while it is still being decided.
privacyEraseGoes: Their name, birth date, photo, contact details, sign-in and the work they handed in will be destroyed.
privacyEraseStays: Grades, attendance and class records stay as the school's records, attached to no one. The approval is kept as proof.
privacyErasuresHint: Each erasure's approval stays as proof of what was destroyed, when and on whose authority.
privacyErasureUnavailable: Erasure is not yet switched on for this school's server. Ask Farida support to turn it on.
privacyRunErasureBody: The erasure was approved but did not finish. Running it destroys this person's data. This cannot be undone.
privacyTypeNameMismatch: Type the name exactly as shown.
privacyErrErasureHeld: A legal hold names this person, so nothing about them can be erased.
privacyErrErasureRequested: A records request about this person is still open.
privacyErrErasureExam: Their exam coursework must be kept until its session's date.
privacyErrNotLeaver: Only someone who has left the school can be erased.
privacyErrNotYetDue: Their records are not yet due under the school's rules.
privacyErrErasureRequestNeeded: Choose the person's open request to erase their records.
privacyErrErasureNotApproved: No erasure has been approved for this person.
privacyErrErased: This person has already been erased.
privacyErrErasureBlocked: The erasure did not run. A legal hold may have been placed since it was approved.
privacyErasureNotRun: The erasure was approved but did not run. Run it again from the list.
privacyErrErasurePending: An erasure is already approved for this person. Run it from the list.
